description: This file is a shell script used for testing git rev-parse and related commands with various parent and revision options. It sets up a test repository, executes numerous tests, and verifies the correctness of git's revision parsing behavior.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev_output
methods.description: Compares the output of git rev-parse with an expected value within the test framework.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected during testing.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or streams to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the test repository.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Pauses or advances the clock in the test environment to create distinct timestamps.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Outputs a sequence of numbers for use in tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
